name: Restaurant Yadorigi
source:
The protagonist, Lucy, has been running the restaurant “Yadorigi” alone after losing her father in an accident.
One day, she loses the secret recipe, making it difficult to recreate her father’s signature flavor.
As customers begin to leave and the restaurant nears closure, her childhood friend—a chef—returns to town.
Encouraged by Lision, she decides to create a “signature dish” using a “special ingredient” together with him.
Will Lucy be able to complete her signature dish?
translation:
The protagonist, Lucy, has been running the restaurant “Yadorigi” alone after losing her father in an accident.
One day, she loses the secret recipe, making it difficult to recreate her father’s signature flavor.
As customers begin to leave and the restaurant nears closure, her childhood friend—a chef—returns to town.
Encouraged by Lision, she decides to create a “signature dish” using a “special ingredient” together with him.
Will Lucy be able to complete her signature dish?
